Module 2: AI Agents

Design sub-agents, skills, and plugins for production-ready applications.Interface-based learning without terminal requirements.

Sub-Agent Design

Create sub-agents that handle specific domains while coordinating througha central orchestrator pattern. Learn the lifecycle of sub-agent creation,spawning, and termination.

Plugin Architecture

Develop custom plugins and skills that integrate with the Claude Codeecosystem. Learn plugin manifest structure, dependency management,and hot-reloading capabilities.

Interface-Based Patterns

All lessons in this module are conducted through the visual interfacewith natural language prompts. No terminal required for the first 3modules - learn Claude Code fundamentals entirely through the UI.

Direct UI Interaction

Interactive panels where you configure sub-agent hierarchies, pluginmanifests, and skill compositions through point-and-click interfaceswith live preview.

Terminal-Inclusive Commands

rtk gain shows token savings analyticsrtk gain --history shows command usage history with savingsrtk discover analyzes Claude Code history for missed opportunitiesrtk proxy executes raw commands without filtering
